name: RegentFX Fast Boot
author: omp
description: Conditional boot-stall fix for RegentFX. Requires RegentFXFastBoot to load BEFORE RegentFX. The game's modding screen cannot reorder mods, so set the order with a load-order editor: Load Order Manager (Steam Workshop 3747605109) adds a Load Order button to the modding screen - move RegentFXFastBoot above RegentFX, Apply, restart. Keep exactly ONE RegentFXFastBoot install: a local copy plus a workshop copy adds a second row later in mod_list, and sorting keys priorities by id with last index winning, so that later row overrides the enabled one and forces late order every launch. In the correct order it skips RegentFX's synchronous scene preload (only when RegentFX's own PreloadEffects setting is on) and re-warms the same scene cache one scene per frame from the live NGame during menu idle time. If RegentFX initializes first, this launch is late-order: nothing is suppressed or warmed, and the log says so. First-combat warmth depends on timing and is not guaranteed. Requires RegentFX to be installed; BaseLib is no longer required.
